summary: 46-year-old woman with an intermittent left groin bulge. In women HerniaSurge recommends considering a femoral hernia and suggests a laparoscopic repair (identifies occult femoral defects); watchful waiting is not advised because of the femoral-hernia risk.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Intermittent lump in the left groin
inputs.hpi: Four months of an intermittent left groin lump, worse after lifting her grandchild, with a sharp twinge on coughing. Goes away overnight. No vomiting, no change in bowel habit. LMP 2 weeks ago, regular cycles, not pregnant.

exam.abdomen: Soft. Left groin: small reducible swelling near the pubic tubercle with a cough impulse; its relation to the inguinal ligament is difficult to define clinically. Right groin normal.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Left groin hernia (inguinal vs femoral) in a woman
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Symptomatic left groin hernia in a woman — inguinal vs femoral not certain clinically. Plan laparoscopic repair (TEP/TAPP) to assess the femoral canal.

mustNotMiss.note: HerniaSurge: femoral hernias are relatively common in women with groin hernias and are frequently misdiagnosed as inguinal.

mustInclude.note: HerniaSurge suggests a laparoscopic approach for groin hernia repair in women (occult femoral hernia).
mustInclude.knownGapNote: iOS CI 2026-09-25 (run 36169134350, database mode): no management item matched among 3 (ios.pipeline.actions, ios.soap.plan)

mustExclude.note: Watchful waiting is a men-only option in HerniaSurge; in women the femoral-hernia (strangulation) risk argues for repair.
Orders seeded from the PANE top 3 should belong to the groin presentation.

guideline.name: HerniaSurge — International guidelines for groin hernia management
guideline.section: Diagnosis (clinical examination, ultrasound for uncertain swellings); watchful waiting in minimally symptomatic men; mesh repair (Lichtenstein, TEP/TAPP); groin hernia in women; femoral hernia; emergency repair
guideline.citation: HerniaSurge Group. International guidelines for groin hernia management. Hernia. 2018;22:1–165.

rationale: Permutation: sex. Same presentation as the base in a woman; the expected plan changes (femoral must be considered, laparoscopic repair suggested, no watchful waiting).
